gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed with no prior surgery, radiation, chemotherapy, or other tumor-treating agent

candidate_evidence.quote: Drugs like Acetadote, which affect the level of damage in a cell (oxidative stress), may impact brain tumor metabolism and slow the growth of brain tumors.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Prospective, Open-label Phase 0 Single-center Study to Assess the Effect of Acetadote on Metabolism in Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: The effect of Acetadote on glioblastoma metabolism in resected tumor tissue will be measured by Liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LCMS).

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: The effect of Acetadote on glioblastoma metabolism will be assessed by measuring cysteine, glutathione, and lactate in glioblastoma through MRS.
The effect of Acetadote on glioblastoma metabolism in resected tumor tissue will be measured by Liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LCMS).

role_evidence.quote: Acetadote will be administered at a dose of 150 mg/kg IV over 60 minutes.
This goal of this clinical trial is to evaluate how Acetadote affects metabolism in patients with glioblastoma.

agents.drug_class_hint: N-acetylcysteine IV (Acetadote; paracetamol overdose antidote, antioxidant)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: affects oxidative stress; may impact brain tumor metabolism and slow the growth of brain tumors

biomarkers.biomarker_other: tumour cysteine, glutathione and lactate (MRS) and tumour tissue metabolites (LCMS)

source_quote.quote: The effect of Acetadote on glioblastoma metabolism will be assessed by measuring cysteine, glutathione, and lactate in glioblastoma through MRS.

coder_notes: Early Phase 1 (phase 0) window study of IV acetylcysteine (Acetadote) before resection in newly diagnosed GBM; translational subset. Stated antitumour hypothesis (oxidative stress, tumour metabolism). Tumour cysteine/glutathione by MRS and tissue LCMS are framed as metabolic (pharmacodynamic) effects, not as drug concentration; tumour_pk_planned coded no, though tumour cysteine could be read as a drug-derived level (adjudicator may consider unclear). No radiotherapy or other drug in the arm -> monotherapy.
